# SafeGen

> SafeGen keeps a register of Australian phone numbers that parents have put on the Safe List because they belong to a child. Platforms check a number at sign-up and refuse accounts the parent has asked to block.

## Start here

- https://ricricho.github.io/safegen-docs/docs/agent-discovery.html - step-by-step guide for visiting agents
- https://www.safegen.com.au/api-docs - platform guide on the live site
- https://www.safegen.com.au/developers/sign-up - self-serve test key

## API (live)

- POST https://www.safegen.com.au/api/integrations/signup - JSON {orgName (required), contactName, contactEmail, website}; returns a test key (sg_test_...)
- POST https://www.safegen.com.au/api/check - header Authorization: Bearer <key>; JSON {countryCode, phone}; returns {listed, blockRequested, action, checkedAt}. Without a key: 401.
- Test keys accept only fixture:match, fixture:no-match, fixture:no-block, fixture:unknown, fixture:error, and are rate limited per hour.
- POST https://www.safegen.com.au/api/integrations/request-production - with a test key; SafeGen reviews the organisation, then issues a production key.
- GET https://www.safegen.com.au/api/stats - public counters

## Reading a result

- action "reject": do not create the account.
- action "allow": carry on with your other checks. Not being on the list is not proof of adulthood.
- action "unknown" or an error: hold the sign-up for retry or review.

## Offline practice kit

- https://github.com/RicRicho/safegen-evaluation-kit (MIT, v0.1.0): node --test test.mjs (12 tests), node example.mjs. Runs on 127.0.0.1 with practice numbers only.
